title: CallLint canonical subject
description: The resolved product/tool IDENTITY in the Canonical Adoption Index (calllint.canonical-subject.v1; §7.1, ADR 0061). Distinct from calllint.source-record.v1, which records what one source claimed: a subject is what identity resolution CONCLUDED across records, and `identityBasis` names the evidence for that conclusion. `identityStatus` is a fail-closed lifecycle — `CONFLICT` is TERMINAL and never a warning, because silently merging two products under one identity would attach one product's evidence to the other's page. `PROVISIONAL` means resolved-from-a-single-source (§8.1: the Official MCP Registry canonical name is the Phase 2.3 seed identity, and broad multi-source merges stay off in the first release). Written by R-3; the table and schema land in R-1 so the canonical DDL cannot drift table by table.
